source_text: (Rufinus II.11 on promises / close of book II)
pass_a_gloss: On the promises: hope is not emptied, nor resurrection reduced to mere allegory.
pass_b_english: The Savior’s incarnation, the Spirit’s work, the soul, the motions of rational creatures, and resurrection-and-judgment are treated in order. Promises are not emptied into mere metaphor, nor is the resurrection made a crass flesh-only hope. BOOK II CLOSEOUT.
